  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Tree house requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Tree house draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialsOrder" name="Materials order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderProcessed" name="Materials order processed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the house"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartyInvitation" name="Tree house party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineStores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect" messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MaterialsOrder" name="Materials order" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_OnlineStores" messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderProcessed" name="Materials order processed" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineStores" targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed" messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the house" sourceRef="Task_MessageFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartyInvitation" name="Party invitation" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_PartyInvitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BuildingHouse" name="Begin building a tree house">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft" messageRef="Message_Draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Refinements" name="Refine the draft further?" default="Flow_8">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft with additional requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements to architect" messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinConcurrentActivities" name="Order processed and friends messaged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of people attending the party for buying snacks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_Refinements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" name="Further refinement" sourceRef="Gateway_Refinements" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft">
